Wedding ( German : der Wedding , pronounced [ˈvɛdɪŋ] ⓘ ) is a locality in the borough of Mitte , Berlin , Germany. It was a separate borough in the north-western inner city until it was fused with Tiergarten and Mitte in Berlin's 2001 administrative reform . At the same time the eastern half of the former borough of Wedding—on the other side of Reinickendorfer Straße—was separated as the new locality of Gesundbrunnen .
